notes: Dressing up and walking a runway is the Dress Up preset outright, and this is the one avatar prompt that keeps the preset's own stage-runway shape — a catwalk fed by preparation booths with the audience arranged around it — so no substitution was needed. The answers remove the judging, but that changes gameplay rather than the space: an unjudged walk and a scored one build the same catwalk, so I kept the shape and simply placed no scoring volume. The fake social feed is UI, and its layout half is vignette-photo, the composed backdrops players shoot their outfits against, which the preset already carries alongside the gathering space. With no user to ask I assumed a glossy indoor show venue as answered, treated the changing booths as part of the runway shape rather than as separate interiors, and took the end of the catwalk as the place the run terminates.
